description: Detect the language of a text with franc-min (82 languages with 8M+ speakers, ISO 639-3 codes) and the writing systems it uses (Latin, Arabic, Cyrillic, Han/CJK, Hangul, Devanagari, Greek, Hebrew, Thai…). Returns the top 3 candidates with scores (1 = best match, relative to the others), English names and ISO 639-1 codes where they exist, plus a share per script. Texts under 20 characters are "too short": only the script is reported. Works best on a sentence or more of one language; for mixed text the dominant script wins; long texts are judged on their first 100,000 characters. Hebrew is not among the languages (script only). Give "text" or "path" (file path or base64).

path.description: Or: a UTF-8 text/markdown file, as a local path or base64 (raw or a data: URI).

name: ai_detect_language
title: Detect language
